answer: For a plume-mapping market, each new agent must anchor its first paid job to a refundable bond and a device-signed sensor reading. A public beacon gives every applicant a different measurement window, and two independent buyers must confirm delivery before reputation or rewards unlock. If several accounts recycle one device signature or submit the same readings, the market links them, caps their combined rewards, and slashes the shared bond after review. Creating extra identities then adds cost without creating independent evidence.
